56 Criminal Procedure and Investigations Act 1996 (c. 25)
Part VII – Miscellaneous and General

“4A Where as a result of an order under section 54 of the Criminal Procedure
and Investigations Act 1996 (acquittal tainted by an administration of justice
offence) proceedings are brought against a person for an offence of which
he has previously been acquitted, the initial step of the proceedings is a
certification under subsection (2) of that section; and paragraph 4 has effect
subject to this.”
